raw_segments.text: Paris, Raleigh waking, crude sunlight on her lemon streets, moist pith of farls of bread,
the frog-green wormhood, her matine incense, court the air.
Belluomo rises from the bed of his wife's lover's wife.
The kerchiefed housewife is a stir, a saucer of acetic acid in her hand.
In Rodot's Yvonne and Madeline, new make their tumbled beauties, shattering with gold-teeth
chossons of pastry, their mouths yellowed with the pus of flan brayton.
Faces of Paris men go by, their well-pleased pleasers, curled conquistadories.
